node.title: Re: Push array to hash
node.author: BillKSmith
node.doctext:
Your dump is telling you that you that you have pushed multiple reference to the same variable. There is no point in printing its value multiple times. I cannot offer a real fix without seeing the declaration of your variables and the statement that prints the dump. Perhaps you need: push( @{ $self->{"lags"} }, {%lag_detail} );

This would push a reference to an anonymous hash which contains a current copy of your hash.

Bill
